title: The $3.2 Trillion Question Hiding in Plain Sight
subtitle: NVIDIA’s Record Quarter and the Off-Balance-Sheet AI Infrastructure Commitments of the AI-7
description: NVIDIA reported record Q2 FY2027 results while research revealed that the AI-7 companies now carry approximately $3.2 trillion in contractual commitments largely sitting in footnotes. This episode teaches students how to read true committed capital, utilisation risk, and the difference between reported leverage and reality.
sources: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2027, NVIDIA Newsroom, 26 August 2026
NVIDIA Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended 26 July 2026
KBRA Research: AI Credit – Off to the Races, 26 August 2026
